CustomField.description: API name of the source record to map to the target field. For example, the unique column name in a report or list view. Required when Mapping Type is "Source Field"; left blank when Mapping Type is "Static Value". Requiredness is enforced conditionally in the UI and in Apex rather than by the field definition.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: API name of the source record to map to the target field. For example, the unique column name in a report or list view. Leave blank when Mapping Type is "Static Value".
CustomField.label: Source Field Name
